name: intelligent-search-benchmark
description:
Dataset Description
	

This dataset contains evaluation queries and ground-truth relevance labels used to benchmark Intelligent Search at scale. It is intended for retrieval evaluation, not model training.

	
		
		Data Sources
	


Curated JSONL files with user-style queries and top-k labeled relevant messages.
Each dataset file corresponds to a distinct thematic domain (e.g., support, engineering, product, general chat).
